searchText: I'm implementing sync and it's very annoying having to read another block to know which pre-state you need to process a block Now to process a block you need to - fetch block N - fetch parent(block N) - fetch pre-state for block N, based on parent(block N) - run state transition This extra dependency is awakward Is this forward sync? Why wouldn't you have the parent information already in forkchoice in that case? You do not run forkchoice when forward syncing?

Now to process a block you need to
- fetch block N
- fetch parent(block N)
- fetch pre-state for block N, based on  parent(block N)
- run state transition

This extra dependency is awakward

excerpts.content: Why wouldn't you have the parent information already in forkchoice in that case? You do not run forkchoice when forward syncing?
